title: A closer look at CAE Rise at NBAA 2022
body_markdown: CAE's Terry Constatakis has been talking to customers at #NBAA2022 about how the data-driven CAE Rise training system elevates human performance and enhances the safety of their operation. Check it out below or go to[https://www.cae.com/nbaa-2022/](https://www.cae.com/nbaa-2022/) for a more detailed look at CAE Rise.
